أُشْخُوبٌ The sound of the streaming of milk. (S, O, K.) ―
-b2- [And it seems to be used as an epithet; for it is added that] one says, إِنَّهَا لَأُشْخُوبُ الأَحَالِيلِ [app. meaning Verily she is one whereof the orifices of the teats produce a sound by the streaming of the milk]. (S, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
